genres.name: classic rock
genres.description: Anthemic riffs, powerful vocals, and timeless songs from the 60s to the 80s, shaping the golden era of rock and roll.

genres.name: psychedelic rock
genres.description: Swirling organs, experimental guitars, and surreal lyrics capture the 60s counterculture, creating dreamlike soundscapes that transport listeners beyond ordinary rock boundaries.

genres.name: metal
genres.description: Explosive distortion, thunderous drums, and intense vocals form a heavy, aggressive style that channels raw energy and darker themes into powerful music.

genres.name: progressive rock
genres.album: In The Court Of The Crimson King (Expanded & Remastered Original Album Mix)
genres.description: Ambitious compositions with shifting time signatures and varied instrumentation, blending rock with classical and jazz influences to create complex, immersive musical journeys.

genres.name: hard rock
genres.description: Bold guitar riffs, pounding drums, and soaring vocals deliver raw energy and intensity, bringing rock to its most electrifying and powerful expression.

genres.name: funk rock
genres.description: Groovy basslines and syncopated rhythms collide with gritty guitars, creating a high-energy blend of funk’s rhythm and rock’s fiery edge.

genres.name: alternative rock
genres.description: Inventive sounds and emotional lyrics break from mainstream formulas, offering edgy guitars, fresh ideas, and a balance of vulnerability and raw energy.

genres.name: industrial metal
genres.description: Mechanical rhythms, distorted guitars, and electronic noise merge into an abrasive, dystopian soundscape that feels both futuristic and intensely aggressive.

genres.name: grunge
genres.description: Distorted guitars, gritty vocals, and unpolished production express raw emotion, capturing frustration, alienation, and honesty at the heart of 90s rock.

genres.name: yacht rock
genres.description: Smooth melodies, polished arrangements, and breezy harmonies create a relaxed, radio-friendly style perfect for warm nights, coastal drives, and easy listening.

genres.name: blues rock
genres.description: Soulful guitar solos, blues scales, and heartfelt vocals meet amplified energy, blending traditional blues emotion with the power and drive of rock.

genres.name: art rock
genres.description: Ambitious concepts, experimental sounds, and unconventional structures push rock into artistic territory, crafting music that’s challenging, thought-provoking, and creatively bold.
